text: CSLib Propositional ND: the explosion property module already exists definitionally as `class IsIntuitionistic (T)` with `IsIntuitionistic T ↔ IPL ⊆ T` (Cslib/Logics/Propositional/Defs.lean:166-171). The gated `efq [IsIntuitionistic T]` constructor (NaturalDeduction/Basic.lean:155) is unconstructible at MPL strength because `min_consistent` (MinLindenbaum.lean:27) blocks any IsIntuitionistic instance for AxiomTheory MinPropAxiom. So MPL is operationally the efq-free fragment; re-framing the 398 gate as an additive explosion module needs no inversion.

CSLib naming: NOTATION.md covers transition/equivalence notation only, not typeclass naming. De facto convention is `Is*` for Prop-mixin property classes (IsIntuitionistic, IsClassical, IsBotFree) and Mathlib Bot/OrderBot for structure. Avoid coining new `Has*` classes (e.g. HasExplosion) that duplicate an existing `Is*` property.
